brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, PNG, landscape 16:9, 2048x1152 preferred, at least 1000px wide. This is a new illustration, not a photo or a collage.

The fixed article is about Japan's men's national team World Cup qualifying Window5, Lebanon/Qatar schedule and broadcast information, and 18 players called to the pre-event camp. The 12 actual game participants have NOT yet been announced. Content on the image must be ONLY the exact text below. It must not imply a confirmed game appearance, a result, or a personal achievement.

Design: match the approved black-and-lime sports editorial style observed in B-culver-black-lime-v3.png: deep near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, restrained orange basketball. Bold Japanese gothic typography with hand-painted ink and dry-brush accents, angular energetic strokes, high contrast, generous negative space, very few elements. No logos at all. This is a premium readable thumbnail, not a busy infographic. Do not reuse the reference's player, score, names, or date.

Subject: exactly one real basketball player, Alex Kirk / アレックス・カーク, selected randomly from the 18-player camp list. His name must NOT appear as visible text. Face is based on his official Kawasaki Brave Thunders profile portrait viewed for this task at https://kawasaki-bravethunders.com/team/players/detail/id=25403?PlayerID=12582 (portrait image https://kawasaki-bravethunders.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1787897527/files/user/_/team/players/2026-2027/53.jpg). Appearance observed: tall powerful broad-shouldered light-skinned adult man; broad oval-to-square face, high forehead, slightly receding hairline, short light-brown hair brushed to the side with shorter temples; close-cropped light-brown stubble beard and moustache, pale blue eyes, fairly straight nose, thin lips, strong jaw. Preserve recognizable facial structure. Not an invented generic player. Render all features as expressive black and ivory ink illustration with selective hatching, never photographic skin or a pasted/cutout photograph. Plain ivory basketball jersey with dark trim, no letters, no numbers, no crest, no sponsor, no team or league logos.

Action/composition: right 42% of frame contains Kirk dynamically gathering a rebound in BOTH hands above and slightly to the side of his head, torso twisting diagonally, elbows naturally bent, intense focused face in a clear three-quarter view, face unobscured. Ball firmly in the hands, complete ball within frame. Both hands anatomically plausible, five fingers per hand with natural occlusion, only two arms. Head, hands, ball and elbows fully within safe margins. Frame upper thighs upwards, allow only intentional lower-torso crop at bottom. One bold diagonal lime brush stroke behind him provides motion. No opponent, no audience, no real venue, no scoreboard or identifiable game. This is an imagined basketball motion, not a recreation of a real play.

Left 58%: strong typographic hierarchy. All visible Japanese text must be exactly spelled, undistorted, readable, high contrast. Keep text away from face/arms/ball. 70px or larger safe margin all sides. Top left small site/date line, then smaller kicker, then very large two-line headline, then medium supporting line and clear qualifier. Bottom left footer label readable, about 32px or larger at 2048px width.

Text (verbatim), in this order:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.11.24"
"W杯予選 Window5"
"日本代表"
"日程・放送"
"直前合宿18名"
"試合出場12名は未発表"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Hierarchy: 日本代表 in huge ivory, 日程・放送 in huge lime; 直前合宿18名 in bold ivory at smaller size; 試合出場12名は未発表 noticeably smaller but fully legible. The footer has イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ side by side. All text belongs to the article as a whole, never attach the 18 or 12 to the player's jersey.
Do NOT add any player names, statistics, slogans, logos, watermarks, standings, match results, new dates, venue details, or any other text.

generator.style_reference_observation: view_imageで確認済み。黒#151A18×ライム#CCF43B、太字の日本語、インク・ブラシ表現を使用。A-faison-ivory-v3.pngは指定場所に存在せず、黒地の承認済みB参照で制作。
generator.qa_observation: 生成PNGをview_imageで実確認。全文・数字5/18/12/日付を固定原稿と照合。18名は直前合宿、12名は未発表という留保を明示。顔の髪型・輪郭・ひげ・目鼻を公式写真と比較。両手・2本の腕・ボールの保持、顔・ボール・肘・文字の見切れなしを確認。下半身のみ意図的トリミング。イラスト（AI生成）とイメージの表記を確認。
